ring.note: The bore ring (full height, its top cut to clear the hood's sweep), the 2 NECTAR block teeth (lanes 1 and 3), 2 side ears and 2 back lugs. Each ear: 2 x M4 x 18 down into the 3208 gear, and 2 M4 nuts dropped into its 2 top slots for the plate's 2 x M4 x 20. The lugs and the NECTAR teeth take 4 more M4 only if those gear holes are tapped.

plate_a.note: PLATE A (1/4 in black acetal, laser cut): v3's back exactly (motor, squishy, tie, ears), the front reshaped round the moved flywheel, the hook slots (13.1), the crank's bearing and the toggle servo's window; motor face 4 x M4

plate_b.note: PLATE B (1/4 in black acetal): the same outline, bearings and hook slots; 2 zip-tie holes for the angle servo's lead; no windows. The hook slots' round ends are the hood's seats: tape in them = more squeeze, a file = less

steel_discs.note: 6 x goBILDA 3628-0032-0082 steel flywheel discs, 3 per side (as v3)

fly_hub.note: goBILDA 1309-0016-4008 Sonic Hub on the Hogback's web, 4 x M4 x 10 (as v3)

fly_screws.note: 16 x M4 x 25 thread-forming socket heads through the discs into the Hogback (as v3)

fly_shaft.note: 8 mm REX shaft, 182 mm (cut a goBILDA 2106)

squishy.note: the team's cast squishy wheel (3.5 in, 6 ridges, 40 mm wide): its cast-in hub's hex bore sits straight on the 8 mm REX shaft (the hex drives it), a goBILDA 2910 collar against each face

motor.note: goBILDA 5203-2402-0001 Yellow Jacket 6000 rpm: its face on plate A only (4 x M4 x 14 button heads from outside, no motor cup), 82.5 mm from the flywheel

htd_pulleys.note: 2 x goBILDA 3417-4008-0016 HTD 5M 16T pulleys (1:1) outside plate A (as v3)

htd_belt.note: goBILDA 3412-0009-0245 HTD 5M belt, 9 wide, 245 mm (49T): exact at 82.5 mm centres

fly_spacers.note: 2 x goBILDA 1522 spacers on the flywheel shaft (as v3)

gt2_20t.note: GT2 20T pulley, 8 mm REX (goBILDA 3422-4008-0020 or generic), outside plate B

gt2_pulley.note: SQUISHY PULLEY (PETG): GT2 76T printed (1:3.80), REX bore, 2 flanges

gt2_belt.note: goBILDA 3423-0006-0360 GT2 belt, 6 mm wide, 360 mm (180T): exact at the 130.78 mm centres

tie.note: BACK TIE behind the motor: goBILDA 1516-4008-1200 + 1516-4008-0120 standoffs (132 mm) + 2 x M4 x 10 (as v3, moved)

swivel.note: goBILDA 3208 gear-driven turret (105 bore); its gear's top face = the turret's base plane

crank_arms.note: CRANK ARMS (PETG, solid, 2 prints): r 16, hex REX bores; B has a boss out to plate B's bearing; A (10 mm thick) has the knee bolt's M5 nyloc sunk in its outer face and sits against the 40T

gear_40t.note: goBILDA 2303-4008-0040 steel MOD 0.8 40T, 8 mm REX bore, on the crank shaft (teeth X 46.95-53.45, hub outboard)

knee_rod.note: KNEE: 10 x 1 mm aluminium tube 74.5 mm between the arms + M5 x 90 socket head (head on arm B) + M5 nyloc sunk in arm A

link.note: LINK (laser-cut 1/4 in acetal, with the plates): 41.3 mm between pins (as v3)

toggle_pins.note: hood pin: ISO 7379 6 x 20 shoulder screw (M5) through the clevis + link, nyloc (as v3)

toggle_servo.note: hood servo: goBILDA 2000-0025-0002 (25-2 Torque) on plate A's inner face, body out through the window, 4 x M4 x 16 + nylocs

gear_24t.note: goBILDA 2305-0025-0024 brass MOD 0.8 24T straight on the hood servo's spline (its own screw)

servo_screws.note: 4 x M4 x 16 button heads through the hood servo's ears + plate A, nylocs outside

hood.note: HOOD (PETG, one print): the 3 fixed teeth (lanes 0, 2 and 4) with their entry curves, the webs and the bridge, 2 arc rails with T-slots for the moving teeth, the angle servo's fin, 2 cheeks with 4 roller bosses, the link clevis and a zip-tie block.

hood_teeth.note: MOVING TEETH (PETG, one print): the 2 moving tips (lanes 1 and 3), each with a T-head on its back that slides in the hood's rails, the lead-out bar across all 5 lanes, and the herringbone sector (MOD 1, 286T pitch, 30 deg helix) with its end stops. It swings +-14.5 deg about the hood's pivot.

angle_servo.note: exit-angle servo (goBILDA 2000-0025-0003 Speed) on the hood's fin; 33T pinion to the sector 8.67:1: 29 deg of exit = 251 deg of servo

angle_hub.note: goBILDA 1906-0025-0032 servo hub; the pinion's 4 x M4 x 12 go into its tapped pattern

angle_pinion.note: ANGLE PINION (PETG, solid): 33T MOD 1.0 herringbone, 30 deg helix, 8.4 mm thick, 14 mm bore on the 1906 hub's boss, 4 x M4 x 12 button heads into the hub, no washers

angle_screws.note: 4 x M4 x 20 button heads through the angle servo's ears + the fin, nylocs

ring_screws.note: ring -> 3208 gear: 4 x M4 x 18 socket heads (+ 2 x M4 x 16 at the back lugs, 2 x M4 x 8 in the front holes, only if tapped)

ear_screws_a.note: plate A -> the ring ear's 2 nuts: 2 x M4 x 20 socket heads

bearings_a.note: 3 x goBILDA 1611 in plate A (flywheel, squishy, crank shaft), flange on the OUTER face

rails_a.note: plate A's 2 hood rollers: F686ZZ + ISO 7379 6 x 10 shoulder screw + washer + shims (locates the hood)

ear_screws_b.note: plate B -> the ring ear's 2 nuts: 2 x M4 x 20 socket heads

bearings_b.note: 3 x goBILDA 1611 in plate B (flywheel, squishy, crank shaft), flange on the OUTER face

rails_b.note: plate B's 2 hood rollers: F686ZZ + ISO 7379 6 x 10 shoulder screw + washer (floats)

motor_screws.note: motor face: 4 x M4 button heads from outside plate A

crank_shaft.note: THE FRONT TIE: one 8 mm REX shaft (157 mm) in a 1611 in each plate, a collar outside plate B; the 40T's 2 set screws locate it. Between the 40T's hub and plate A's bearing: goBILDA 1522-0010-0080 (8 mm) + 2807-0811-0250 shim (0.25 mm)

crank_spacer.note: between the 40T's hub and plate A's bearing: goBILDA 1522-0010-0080 (8 mm) + 2807-0811-0250 shim (0.25) = 8.25 mm

sq_collars_in.note: 2 goBILDA 2910 collars against the squishy wheel's faces

sq_collars_out.note: 2 collars: outside plate A, outside the GT2 pulley
